ngsl12:interaction.exampleEnglish: Regular interaction with colleagues from other departments helped Mia understand how the whole company worked.
ngsl12:interaction.exampleChinese: 经常与其他部门的同事交流，帮助米娅理解了整个公司的运作方式。

ngsl12:repair.exampleEnglish: We decided to repair the old bicycle because replacing it would cost considerably more money.
ngsl12:repair.exampleChinese: 我们决定修理那辆旧自行车，因为换一辆的费用高得多。

ngsl12:collapse.exampleEnglish: Engineers closed the bridge after discovering cracks that could cause part of the structure to collapse.
ngsl12:collapse.exampleChinese: 工程师发现可能导致部分结构倒塌的裂缝后，关闭了这座桥。

ngsl12:borrow.exampleEnglish: You can borrow my camera for the weekend provided that you return it before Monday morning.
ngsl12:borrow.exampleChinese: 只要你周一早上前归还，周末就可以借用我的相机。

ngsl12:fundamental.exampleEnglish: Understanding the customer's actual problem is a fundamental step before the team starts designing any solution.
ngsl12:fundamental.exampleChinese: 在团队开始设计解决方案之前，理解客户的实际问题是一个根本步骤。

ngsl12:dish.exampleEnglish: Please place the vegetables in a shallow dish so that everyone at the table can share them.
ngsl12:dish.exampleChinese: 请把蔬菜放在一个浅盘里，让桌上的每个人都能分享。

ngsl12:abroad.exampleEnglish: Although studying abroad was challenging at first, Lena gradually became more confident about living independently.
ngsl12:abroad.exampleChinese: 尽管出国学习起初很有挑战，莉娜逐渐对独立生活更有信心了。

ngsl12:soul.exampleEnglish: The novel follows a musician who believes that honest music can reveal something about the human soul.
ngsl12:soul.exampleChinese: 这部小说讲述了一位音乐家的故事，他相信真诚的音乐能展现人类灵魂的某些方面。

ngsl12:capable.exampleEnglish: With clear instructions and a little practice, the new assistant proved capable of managing the bookings alone.
ngsl12:capable.exampleChinese: 在明确的指导和少量练习后，新助理证明了自己有能力独立管理预订。

ngsl12:defeat.exampleEnglish: Our team hopes to defeat last year's champions, although we know their defence is especially strong.
ngsl12:defeat.exampleChinese: 我们队希望击败去年的冠军，尽管我们知道他们的防守特别强。

ngsl12:presidential.exampleEnglish: The newspaper compared the presidential candidates' education policies rather than focusing only on their personal backgrounds.
ngsl12:presidential.exampleChinese: 这家报纸比较了总统候选人的教育政策，而非只关注他们的个人背景。

ngsl12:perfectly.exampleEnglish: The replacement part fitted perfectly, so we were able to use the machine again that afternoon.
ngsl12:perfectly.exampleChinese: 替换零件完全吻合，因此我们当天下午就又能使用那台机器了。

ngsl12:enhance.exampleEnglish: Adding a few clear diagrams can enhance your report without making the main argument more complicated.
ngsl12:enhance.exampleChinese: 添加几幅清晰的图表可以改善报告，又不会使主要论点变得更复杂。

ngsl12:proud.exampleEnglish: After months of careful practice, Ella felt proud that she could finally perform the whole piece confidently.
ngsl12:proud.exampleChinese: 经过几个月的认真练习，艾拉为自己终于能自信地演奏整首曲子而感到自豪。

ngsl12:emergency.exampleEnglish: During the emergency, staff guided visitors towards the exits while another colleague called for professional help.
ngsl12:emergency.exampleChinese: 紧急情况发生时，工作人员引导游客走向出口，另一位同事则打电话寻求专业帮助。

ngsl12:educational.exampleEnglish: The museum offers educational activities that encourage children to ask questions instead of simply memorizing facts.
ngsl12:educational.exampleChinese: 这家博物馆提供教育活动，鼓励孩子提问，而不是仅仅记忆事实。

ngsl12:distinguish.exampleEnglish: It can be difficult to distinguish these two birds unless you notice the colour around their eyes.
ngsl12:distinguish.exampleChinese: 如果没有注意到眼睛周围的颜色，就很难区分这两种鸟。

ngsl12:substantial.exampleEnglish: By sharing equipment with nearby schools, the club made substantial savings without reducing the quality of training.
ngsl12:substantial.exampleChinese: 通过与附近学校共用设备，俱乐部节省了大量费用，同时没有降低训练质量。

ngsl12:nearby.exampleEnglish: We chose a nearby restaurant because our train was leaving soon and we had several heavy bags.
ngsl12:nearby.exampleChinese: 我们选了一家附近的餐馆，因为火车很快就要开了，而且我们带着几个沉重的包。

ngsl12:manufacturer.exampleEnglish: Before buying the replacement battery, check whether the manufacturer recommends it for your particular model of camera.
ngsl12:manufacturer.exampleChinese: 购买替换电池之前，请检查制造商是否建议将其用于你的相机型号。

ngsl12:slide.exampleEnglish: Hold the tray level so that the glasses do not slide towards the edge when you move.
ngsl12:slide.exampleChinese: 端托盘时要保持水平，以免移动时杯子滑向边缘。

ngsl12:valuable.exampleEnglish: The family kept the valuable painting in a secure room while the rest of the house was renovated.
ngsl12:valuable.exampleChinese: 房子其他部分翻修时，这家人把那幅贵重的画保存在一个安全的房间里。

ngsl12:personally.exampleEnglish: Although her assistant arranged the meeting, the director personally welcomed each guest and explained the day's schedule.
ngsl12:personally.exampleChinese: 虽然是助理安排的会议，主任仍亲自欢迎每位来宾，并介绍了当天的日程。

ngsl12:breast.exampleEnglish: The mother held her baby close to her breast while the nurse quietly answered her questions.
ngsl12:breast.exampleChinese: 母亲把婴儿抱在胸前，护士则轻声回答她的问题。

collocations.english: hold a baby to the breast

ngsl12:cope.exampleEnglish: Sharing the household tasks helped the family cope with a busy period when both parents were working overtime.
ngsl12:cope.exampleChinese: 父母都加班的那段忙碌时期，分担家务帮助这个家庭顺利应对。

ngsl12:approximately.exampleEnglish: The walk takes approximately forty minutes, although you should allow extra time if you stop for photographs.
ngsl12:approximately.exampleChinese: 步行大约需要四十分钟，不过如果停下来拍照，就应该多留一些时间。

ngsl12:accommodation.exampleEnglish: We booked accommodation near the station so that we would not need a taxi after arriving late.
ngsl12:accommodation.exampleChinese: 我们预订了车站附近的住宿，这样晚到后就不必乘出租车了。

ngsl12:highlight.exampleEnglish: For most visitors, the highlight of the tour was watching young turtles return safely to the sea.
ngsl12:highlight.exampleChinese: 对大多数游客而言，旅程最精彩的部分是看小海龟安全地回到大海。

collocations.chinese: 个人最难忘的精彩时刻

ngsl12:reporter.exampleEnglish: The reporter interviewed several local residents before writing an article about how the new railway affected them.
ngsl12:reporter.exampleChinese: 这位记者在撰写新铁路如何影响当地居民的文章前，采访了几位居民。

ngsl12:climate.exampleEnglish: The island has a mild climate, which makes outdoor activities possible during most months of the year.
ngsl12:climate.exampleChinese: 这座岛气候温和，因此一年中大多数月份都可以开展户外活动。

ngsl12:shirt.exampleEnglish: I packed an extra shirt in case the afternoon walk left me too hot and uncomfortable.
ngsl12:shirt.exampleChinese: 我多带了一件衬衫，以防下午步行后觉得太热、不舒服。

ngsl12:exception.exampleEnglish: Everyone must attend the safety briefing, and visitors are no exception even if they have been here before.
ngsl12:exception.exampleChinese: 每个人都必须参加安全说明会，游客也不例外，即使他们以前来过这里。

ngsl12:corporation.exampleEnglish: The small business joined a larger corporation but kept its original name and most of its staff.
ngsl12:corporation.exampleChinese: 这家小企业加入了一家更大的公司，但保留了原来的名称和大部分员工。

ngsl12:chip.exampleEnglish: A small chip of wood broke off the chair when it caught against the narrow doorway.
ngsl12:chip.exampleChinese: 椅子卡在狭窄的门口时，掉下了一小块木片。

ngsl12:winner.exampleEnglish: The winner thanked her coach, who had encouraged her to continue when progress seemed frustratingly slow.
ngsl12:winner.exampleChinese: 获胜者感谢了教练；在进步慢得让人沮丧时，教练曾鼓励她坚持下去。

ngsl12:encounter.exampleEnglish: If you encounter a problem during registration, contact the support team rather than creating another account.
ngsl12:encounter.exampleChinese: 如果注册时遇到问题，请联系支持团队，而不要另建一个账户。

ngsl12:brown.exampleEnglish: We painted the shelves brown because the darker colour matched the wooden doors in the room.
ngsl12:brown.exampleChinese: 我们把架子漆成棕色，因为这个深色与房间里的木门相配。

ngsl12:breathe.exampleEnglish: After climbing the steep hill, we stopped for a moment so that everyone could breathe more easily.
ngsl12:breathe.exampleChinese: 爬上陡峭的山坡后，我们停了一会儿，让每个人都能喘口气。

ngsl12:excuse.exampleEnglish: He tried to excuse his late arrival by explaining that his train had been delayed outside the station.
ngsl12:excuse.exampleChinese: 他试图以火车在站外延误为由，为自己的迟到辩解。

ngsl12:partly.exampleEnglish: The event succeeded partly because local volunteers offered their time and helped visitors find their way.
ngsl12:partly.exampleChinese: 活动的成功部分归功于当地志愿者，他们投入时间，帮助游客指路。

ngsl12:tennis.exampleEnglish: We usually play tennis on Saturday mornings unless the weather makes the outdoor courts too slippery.
ngsl12:tennis.exampleChinese: 我们通常在周六上午打网球，除非天气使室外球场太滑。

ngsl12:urban.exampleEnglish: The research compares urban gardens with those in the countryside to understand how different plants attract insects.
ngsl12:urban.exampleChinese: 这项研究比较城市花园与乡村花园，以了解不同植物如何吸引昆虫。

ngsl12:confuse.exampleEnglish: Using similar colours for different routes may confuse passengers who are trying to read the map quickly.
ngsl12:confuse.exampleChinese: 用相似的颜色标示不同路线，可能会让想快速读图的乘客困惑。

ngsl12:southern.exampleEnglish: The southern part of the island receives less rain, so farmers there grow different kinds of crops.
ngsl12:southern.exampleChinese: 岛的南部降雨较少，因此那里的农民种植不同种类的作物。

ngsl12:output.exampleEnglish: The factory increased its output after workers suggested a simpler method of checking products for faults.
ngsl12:output.exampleChinese: 工人建议了一种更简单的产品缺陷检查方法后，工厂提高了产量。

ngsl12:beauty.exampleEnglish: We paused to enjoy the beauty of the valley before the afternoon clouds covered the mountains.
ngsl12:beauty.exampleChinese: 下午的云层遮住群山之前，我们停下来欣赏山谷的美景。

ngsl12:massive.exampleEnglish: The town built a massive wall along the river after several years of unusually heavy winter rain.
ngsl12:massive.exampleChinese: 连续几年冬季降雨异常充沛后，这个镇沿河建了一道巨大的墙。

ngsl12:install.exampleEnglish: The technician will install the new printer once we have cleared enough space near the office window.
ngsl12:install.exampleChinese: 等我们在办公室窗边腾出足够空间后，技术人员就会安装新打印机。

ngsl12:calculate.exampleEnglish: Before choosing a delivery service, calculate the total cost including any extra charges for heavy packages.
ngsl12:calculate.exampleChinese: 选择配送服务前，要计算包含重包裹附加费在内的总费用。

ngsl12:mouse.exampleEnglish: A tiny mouse escaped behind the cupboard before we could open the garden door to let it out.
ngsl12:mouse.exampleChinese: 我们还没来得及打开花园门让它出去，一只小老鼠就逃到了柜子后面。

ngsl12:mathematics.exampleEnglish: She began to enjoy mathematics when her teacher showed how it could explain patterns in everyday life.
ngsl12:mathematics.exampleChinese: 老师展示数学如何解释日常生活中的规律后，她开始喜欢上了数学。

ngsl12:upper.exampleEnglish: Please use the upper shelf for lighter boxes because reaching heavy objects above your head is difficult.
ngsl12:upper.exampleChinese: 请把轻箱子放在上层架子，因为拿取头顶上方的重物很困难。

ngsl12:creation.exampleEnglish: The creation of a shared garden gave neighbours a reason to meet and work together every weekend.
ngsl12:creation.exampleChinese: 公共花园的创建让邻居们有了每个周末聚在一起合作的理由。

ngsl12:occupy.exampleEnglish: Our team will occupy the smaller office until the repairs to our usual working space are complete.
ngsl12:occupy.exampleChinese: 在平常办公空间修缮完毕之前，我们团队将使用较小的办公室。

ngsl12:outline.exampleEnglish: Send me a brief outline of your proposal before you spend time preparing the complete presentation.
ngsl12:outline.exampleChinese: 在花时间准备完整的演示之前，先把提案的简要大纲发给我。

ngsl12:sufficient.exampleEnglish: We had sufficient water for the walk, but we decided to carry an extra bottle just in case.
ngsl12:sufficient.exampleChinese: 我们的水够这次步行使用，但还是决定多带一瓶以防万一。

ngsl12:update.exampleEnglish: Please update the contact list whenever a colleague changes their phone number or moves to another department.
ngsl12:update.exampleChinese: 同事更换电话号码或调到另一部门时，请及时更新联系人名单。

ngsl12:luck.exampleEnglish: With a little luck, we will reach the campsite before the rain predicted for this evening begins.
ngsl12:luck.exampleChinese: 如果运气好一点，我们就能赶在预报的今晚降雨开始之前到达营地。

ngsl12:preserve.exampleEnglish: The museum uses special lighting to preserve old photographs while still allowing visitors to examine them closely.
ngsl12:preserve.exampleChinese: 博物馆使用特殊照明保护老照片，同时仍让游客能够近距离观看。

ngsl12:split.exampleEnglish: We agreed to split the bill equally because everyone had ordered food that cost roughly the same.
ngsl12:split.exampleChinese: 我们同意平分账单，因为每个人点的食物价格都大致相同。

ngsl12:swing.exampleEnglish: The branches began to swing in the wind as we hurried along the path towards the shelter.
ngsl12:swing.exampleChinese: 我们沿着小路赶向避雨处时，树枝开始在风中摇摆。

ngsl12:illness.exampleEnglish: During her illness, neighbours brought meals to the house so that the family had one less task.
ngsl12:illness.exampleChinese: 她生病期间，邻居们把饭菜送到家里，让这家人少一件要操心的事。

ngsl12:journalist.exampleEnglish: A responsible journalist checks important claims with several sources before including them in a published report.
ngsl12:journalist.exampleChinese: 负责任的记者会向多个来源核查重要说法，然后才把它们写入发表的报道。

ngsl12:sudden.exampleEnglish: A sudden change in the weather forced us to shorten the walk and return by a safer route.
ngsl12:sudden.exampleChinese: 天气突然变化，迫使我们缩短行程，沿更安全的路线返回。

ngsl12:advertisement.exampleEnglish: The advertisement attracted my attention because it explained clearly how the service could help busy families.
ngsl12:advertisement.exampleChinese: 这则广告吸引了我的注意，因为它清楚说明了该服务如何帮助忙碌的家庭。

ngsl12:consistent.exampleEnglish: The team's results became more consistent after everyone started using the same checklist for each experiment.
ngsl12:consistent.exampleChinese: 每个人开始为每次实验使用同一份检查表后，团队的结果变得更加一致。

ngsl12:originally.exampleEnglish: We originally planned to stay for one night, but the beautiful surroundings persuaded us to extend our visit.
ngsl12:originally.exampleChinese: 我们原本计划只住一晚，但美丽的环境让我们决定延长停留时间。

ngsl12:aside.exampleEnglish: She moved the empty chairs aside so that the visitors could carry their bags through the doorway.
ngsl12:aside.exampleChinese: 她把空椅子移到一旁，让游客能提着行李穿过门口。

ngsl12:comfort.exampleEnglish: After a long journey, the comfort of a quiet room mattered more to us than an expensive view.
ngsl12:comfort.exampleChinese: 长途旅行之后，对我们来说，安静房间的舒适比昂贵的景观房更重要。

ngsl12:secondly.exampleEnglish: Firstly, the new route is shorter; secondly, it avoids the busy road where traffic often becomes dangerous.
ngsl12:secondly.exampleChinese: 首先，新路线更短；其次，它避开了那条交通常常变得危险的繁忙公路。

ngsl12:severe.exampleEnglish: Because of severe weather, the ferry company cancelled all afternoon crossings and offered passengers alternative travel arrangements.
ngsl12:severe.exampleChinese: 由于天气恶劣，渡轮公司取消了下午所有航班，并为乘客提供其他出行安排。

ngsl12:gene.exampleEnglish: The students studied a gene that helps explain why some plants produce flowers of different colours.
ngsl12:gene.exampleChinese: 学生们研究了一个有助于解释某些植物为何开出不同颜色花朵的基因。

ngsl12:prospect.exampleEnglish: The prospect of working with an experienced designer made the training programme especially attractive to recent graduates.
ngsl12:prospect.exampleChinese: 与经验丰富的设计师合作的前景，使这项培训对刚毕业的学生特别有吸引力。

ngsl12:snow.exampleEnglish: Although the road had been cleared, fresh snow made the final part of our journey much slower.
ngsl12:snow.exampleChinese: 虽然道路已经清理过，新下的雪还是让我们最后一段旅程慢了很多。

ngsl12:plot.exampleEnglish: In the novel, a young journalist discovers a plot to steal valuable documents from the city museum.
ngsl12:plot.exampleChinese: 小说中，一位年轻记者发现了一个从城市博物馆窃取珍贵文件的阴谋。

ngsl12:neck.exampleEnglish: My neck felt stiff after the long journey because I had fallen asleep in an uncomfortable position.
ngsl12:neck.exampleChinese: 长途旅行后，我的脖子很僵硬，因为我以不舒服的姿势睡着了。

ngsl12:criteria.exampleEnglish: Before comparing the applications, the committee agreed on clear criteria so that every candidate would be treated fairly.
ngsl12:criteria.exampleChinese: 比较申请材料之前，委员会商定了明确标准，以便公平对待每位候选人。

ngsl12:primarily.exampleEnglish: The centre is designed primarily for local families, although visitors from other areas are also welcome.
ngsl12:primarily.exampleChinese: 这个中心主要为当地家庭设计，不过也欢迎其他地区的游客。

ngsl12:integrate.exampleEnglish: The school plans to integrate music into language lessons so that students can practise rhythm and pronunciation together.
ngsl12:integrate.exampleChinese: 学校计划把音乐融入语言课，让学生能同时练习节奏和发音。

ngsl12:criticism.exampleEnglish: Although the designer welcomed constructive criticism, she asked colleagues to explain which details they thought needed changing.
ngsl12:criticism.exampleChinese: 虽然设计师欢迎建设性批评，她还是请同事说明哪些细节需要修改。

ngsl12:convention.exampleEnglish: At the annual convention, teachers exchanged practical ideas that they could adapt for their own classrooms.
ngsl12:convention.exampleChinese: 在年度大会上，教师们交流了可以调整后用于自己课堂的实用想法。

ngsl12:bet.exampleEnglish: They sometimes bet small amounts on friendly games, but most evenings they play simply for enjoyment.
ngsl12:bet.exampleChinese: 他们有时会在友谊赛中赌一点钱，不过多数晚上都只是为了娱乐而玩。

ngsl12:retain.exampleEnglish: The renovated library will retain its original wooden doors while providing better lighting and more comfortable seating.
ngsl12:retain.exampleChinese: 翻修后的图书馆将保留原来的木门，同时提供更好的照明和更舒适的座位。

ngsl12:sequence.exampleEnglish: Put the photographs in the correct sequence so that visitors can follow how the building changed over time.
ngsl12:sequence.exampleChinese: 把照片按正确顺序排列，让游客看出这栋建筑随时间发生的变化。

ngsl12:plain.exampleEnglish: The guide explained the rules in plain language so that visitors with little experience could understand them.
ngsl12:plain.exampleChinese: 导游用浅显的语言解释规则，让缺乏经验的游客也能理解。

ngsl12:volunteer.exampleEnglish: A local volunteer showed us where to leave our bags before leading us towards the registration desk.
ngsl12:volunteer.exampleChinese: 一位当地志愿者先告诉我们行李放在哪里，然后带我们走向登记台。

ngsl12:rural.exampleEnglish: The project brings reliable internet to rural communities where travelling to the nearest library can take hours.
ngsl12:rural.exampleChinese: 这个项目把可靠的网络带到乡村社区，那里的居民去最近的图书馆可能需要数小时。

ngsl12:calm.exampleEnglish: Even when several passengers complained at once, the assistant remained calm and explained the available options clearly.
ngsl12:calm.exampleChinese: 即使几个乘客同时抱怨，助理仍保持镇定，清楚解释可用的选择。

ngsl12:abandon.exampleEnglish: The family refused to abandon their old dog when they moved into a much smaller apartment.
ngsl12:abandon.exampleChinese: 搬进小得多的公寓时，这家人拒绝抛弃他们的老狗。

ngsl12:examination.exampleEnglish: During the examination, students must work independently even if they find one of the questions unusually difficult.
ngsl12:examination.exampleChinese: 考试期间，学生必须独立作答，即使发现某一道题格外难。

ngsl12:silence.exampleEnglish: We sat in silence for a few moments while everyone considered what the unexpected news might mean.
ngsl12:silence.exampleChinese: 我们安静地坐了一会儿，每个人都在思考这个意外消息可能意味着什么。

ngsl12:rapidly.exampleEnglish: The temperature dropped rapidly after sunset, so we put on warmer clothes before continuing along the path.
ngsl12:rapidly.exampleChinese: 日落后气温迅速下降，因此我们穿上更暖和的衣服才继续沿小路走。

ngsl12:efficient.exampleEnglish: The new booking system is more efficient because staff no longer have to enter the same details twice.
ngsl12:efficient.exampleChinese: 新的预订系统效率更高，因为员工不再需要重复输入相同信息。

ngsl12:revolution.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how the revolution changed ordinary people's lives, rather than describing only famous political leaders.
ngsl12:revolution.exampleChinese: 这家博物馆解释革命如何改变普通人的生活，而不是只介绍著名政治领袖。

ngsl12:delight.exampleEnglish: To the children's delight, the author stayed after the event to answer questions and sign their books.
ngsl12:delight.exampleChinese: 令孩子们高兴的是，作家在活动结束后留下来回答问题，并为他们的书签名。

ngsl12:spell.exampleEnglish: Could you spell your surname slowly so that I can write it correctly on the booking form?
ngsl12:spell.exampleChinese: 你能慢慢拼出姓氏吗？这样我就能在预订表上写对。

ngsl12:premise.exampleEnglish: The proposal rests on the premise that families will use the park more if transport becomes easier.
ngsl12:premise.exampleChinese: 这项提议以交通更方便后家庭会更多使用公园这一前提为基础。

ngsl12:lean.exampleEnglish: Please do not lean over the barrier because the ground on the other side is much lower.
ngsl12:lean.exampleChinese: 请不要把身体探过护栏，因为另一侧的地面低得多。

ngsl12:dramatic.exampleEnglish: A dramatic improvement in water quality brought more birds back to the lake within just two years.
ngsl12:dramatic.exampleChinese: 水质的大幅改善在短短两年内就吸引了更多鸟类回到湖边。

ngsl12:differ.exampleEnglish: Although the two courses differ in length, both provide enough practical experience for students who are just starting.
ngsl12:differ.exampleChinese: 虽然两门课程的时长不同，但都为初学的学生提供了足够的实践经验。

ngsl12:grateful.exampleEnglish: We were grateful to the neighbours who looked after our plants while we were away visiting relatives.
ngsl12:grateful.exampleChinese: 我们很感激那些在我们外出探亲时帮忙照料植物的邻居。

ngsl12:protein.exampleEnglish: The class compared how much protein different foods contained before planning a balanced meal for a school trip.
ngsl12:protein.exampleChinese: 全班在为学校旅行设计均衡餐食之前，比较了不同食物所含的蛋白质量。

ngsl12:bike.exampleEnglish: I usually leave my bike inside the station because the covered parking area protects it from rain.
ngsl12:bike.exampleChinese: 我通常把自行车停在车站里面，因为有顶棚的停车区能遮雨。

ngsl12:distribute.exampleEnglish: The volunteers will distribute maps at the entrance so that visitors can explore the village without getting lost.
ngsl12:distribute.exampleChinese: 志愿者将在入口处分发地图，让游客能在村里游览而不迷路。

ngsl12:intellectual.exampleEnglish: The course offers an intellectual challenge while encouraging students to connect abstract ideas with familiar everyday experiences.
ngsl12:intellectual.exampleChinese: 这门课带来智力上的挑战，同时鼓励学生把抽象概念与熟悉的日常经历联系起来。
ngsl12:intellectual.chinese: 智力的；思维的（此处为形容词义项）

ngsl12:derive.exampleEnglish: Many English words derive from Latin, which sometimes helps learners recognize the meaning of an unfamiliar expression.
ngsl12:derive.exampleChinese: 很多英语单词源自拉丁语，这有时能帮助学习者辨认陌生表达的含义。

ngsl12:crucial.exampleEnglish: It is crucial to check the measurements before ordering materials because mistakes can be expensive to correct.
ngsl12:crucial.exampleChinese: 订购材料前检查尺寸至关重要，因为纠正错误可能代价很高。

ngsl12:unemployment.exampleEnglish: The report shows that unemployment fell after several local businesses began offering training to people seeking work.
ngsl12:unemployment.exampleChinese: 报告显示，几家当地企业开始为求职者提供培训后，失业率下降了。

ngsl12:wheel.exampleEnglish: One wheel came loose during the journey, so the driver stopped immediately and called for assistance.
ngsl12:wheel.exampleChinese: 旅途中一个车轮松了，因此司机立即停车并打电话求助。

ngsl12:crop.exampleEnglish: Farmers changed the crop they grew after discovering that the soil was better suited to beans.
ngsl12:crop.exampleChinese: 发现这片土壤更适合种豆子后，农民更换了种植的作物。

ngsl12:minority.exampleEnglish: Only a minority of residents opposed the plan, although the council still considered their concerns carefully.
ngsl12:minority.exampleChinese: 虽然只有少数居民反对该计划，市政委员会仍认真考虑了他们的担忧。

ngsl12:origin.exampleEnglish: Researchers traced the origin of the story by comparing versions that had been recorded in different villages.
ngsl12:origin.exampleChinese: 研究人员比较了不同村庄记录的版本，从而追溯这个故事的起源。

ngsl12:interpretation.exampleEnglish: Your interpretation of the final scene is interesting, although I understood the character's silence in a different way.
ngsl12:interpretation.exampleChinese: 你对最后一幕的解读很有意思，不过我对那个角色的沉默有不同理解。

ngsl12:gentleman.exampleEnglish: The elderly gentleman offered us clear directions after noticing that we were struggling to understand the street map.
ngsl12:gentleman.exampleChinese: 那位年长的绅士注意到我们看不懂街道地图，便清楚地为我们指路。

ngsl12:drama.exampleEnglish: The students performed a drama about a family whose members learn to listen to one another.
ngsl12:drama.exampleChinese: 学生们演出了一部戏剧，讲述一家人学会互相倾听的故事。

ngsl12:landscape.exampleEnglish: From the top of the hill, the landscape looked completely different because the river curved away towards the coast.
ngsl12:landscape.exampleChinese: 从山顶看，景色完全不同，因为河流转弯流向海岸。

ngsl12:educate.exampleEnglish: The campaign aims to educate visitors about protecting wildlife without discouraging them from enjoying the national park.
ngsl12:educate.exampleChinese: 这项活动旨在教育游客保护野生动物，同时不影响他们游览国家公园。

ngsl12:toy.exampleEnglish: The child chose a wooden toy that could be taken apart and rebuilt in several different ways.
ngsl12:toy.exampleChinese: 孩子选了一个木制玩具，可以拆开，再用几种不同方式重新组装。

ngsl12:fault.exampleEnglish: The delay was not the driver's fault, since an unexpected road closure had blocked the usual route.
ngsl12:fault.exampleChinese: 延误并不是司机的过错，因为意外封路阻断了通常的路线。

ngsl12:exhibit.exampleEnglish: The gallery will exhibit photographs taken by local students who have been studying the town's changing streets.
ngsl12:exhibit.exampleChinese: 画廊将展出当地学生拍摄的照片；他们一直在研究这座城镇变化中的街道。

ngsl12:minor.exampleEnglish: We made a few minor changes to the design after testing it with people who would use it daily.
ngsl12:minor.exampleChinese: 与日常使用者一起测试后，我们对设计做了几处小修改。

ngsl12:hunt.exampleEnglish: Some wild animals hunt at night because darkness makes it easier to approach their prey without being seen.
ngsl12:hunt.exampleChinese: 有些野生动物夜间捕猎，因为黑暗使它们更容易不被发现地接近猎物。

ngsl12:storm.exampleEnglish: The storm damaged several roofs, but fortunately everyone had reached a safe place before the strongest winds arrived.
ngsl12:storm.exampleChinese: 风暴损坏了几处屋顶，但幸好在最强风力到来前，大家都已到达安全地点。

ngsl12:thick.exampleEnglish: The walls were so thick that we could barely hear the music playing in the room next door.
ngsl12:thick.exampleChinese: 墙太厚了，我们几乎听不到隔壁房间播放的音乐。

ngsl12:achievement.exampleEnglish: Finishing the project together was a real achievement, especially since most team members had never worked together before.
ngsl12:achievement.exampleChinese: 共同完成项目是一个真正的成就，尤其是多数成员之前从未合作过。

ngsl12:negotiate.exampleEnglish: We hope to negotiate a lower price if we agree to order enough materials for the whole year.
ngsl12:negotiate.exampleChinese: 如果同意订购全年所需材料，我们希望能协商出更低的价格。

ngsl12:dominate.exampleEnglish: Larger companies often dominate the market because they can afford advertising that smaller businesses cannot easily match.
ngsl12:dominate.exampleChinese: 大公司常常主导市场，因为它们负担得起小企业难以匹敌的广告投入。

ngsl12:supplier.exampleEnglish: Our usual supplier could not deliver the chairs, so we contacted another company that had them in stock.
ngsl12:supplier.exampleChinese: 常用供应商无法配送这些椅子，因此我们联系了另一家有现货的公司。

ngsl12:prize.exampleEnglish: The prize included a visit to a research centre where the winner could meet scientists and observe their work.
ngsl12:prize.exampleChinese: 奖品包括参观一家研究中心，获胜者可以在那里见科学家并观察他们的工作。

ngsl12:typically.exampleEnglish: The village is typically quiet during the week, although it becomes much busier when tourists arrive at weekends.
ngsl12:typically.exampleChinese: 村子平日通常很安静，不过周末游客到来后就热闹得多。

ngsl12:peer.exampleEnglish: Working with a peer can help you notice mistakes that are difficult to identify in your own writing.
ngsl12:peer.exampleChinese: 与同龄伙伴合作能帮助你发现自己写作中难以察觉的错误。

ngsl12:pension.exampleEnglish: After leaving full-time work, he used part of his pension to travel and visit friends living abroad.
ngsl12:pension.exampleChinese: 离开全职工作后，他把部分退休金用于旅行和探望住在国外的朋友。

ngsl12:wing.exampleEnglish: The bird spread one wing as it rested on the branch, allowing us to see its bright feathers.
ngsl12:wing.exampleChinese: 那只鸟栖息在树枝上时展开了一侧翅膀，让我们看清了鲜艳的羽毛。

ngsl12:acquisition.exampleEnglish: The acquisition of new skills helped her move into a role that required more independent decisions.
ngsl12:acquisition.exampleChinese: 获得新技能帮助她转任了一份需要更多自主决策的工作。

ngsl12:laughter.exampleEnglish: The room filled with laughter when the speaker shared a gentle joke about her first day at work.
ngsl12:laughter.exampleChinese: 演讲者讲了一个有关自己上班第一天的温和笑话，房间里顿时充满笑声。

ngsl12:deeply.exampleEnglish: He was deeply disappointed when the concert was cancelled, since he had been looking forward to it for months.
ngsl12:deeply.exampleChinese: 音乐会取消时，他非常失望，因为他已经盼了好几个月。

ngsl12:recognition.exampleEnglish: The award brought recognition to volunteers whose patient work had made the neighbourhood a friendlier place.
ngsl12:recognition.exampleChinese: 这个奖项让志愿者们获得认可，他们耐心的工作让社区变得更加友善。

ngsl12:electricity.exampleEnglish: The village lost electricity during the storm, so neighbours shared torches while engineers worked to restore the supply.
ngsl12:electricity.exampleChinese: 风暴期间村里停电了，工程师抢修恢复供电时，邻居们共用手电筒。

ngsl12:assistance.exampleEnglish: Passengers who need assistance can speak to a member of staff before the train reaches the station.
ngsl12:assistance.exampleChinese: 需要帮助的乘客可以在列车到站前联系工作人员。

ngsl12:roof.exampleEnglish: We noticed a leak in the roof after water began dripping onto the floor during the night.
ngsl12:roof.exampleChinese: 夜里水开始滴到地板上后，我们发现屋顶有一处漏水。

ngsl12:retirement.exampleEnglish: She looked forward to retirement because it would give her more time to paint and explore the countryside.
ngsl12:retirement.exampleChinese: 她盼望退休，因为那样就有更多时间画画和探索乡间。

ngsl12:respectively.exampleEnglish: Lena and Omar arrived on Monday and Tuesday respectively, so they attended different introductory sessions at the college.
ngsl12:respectively.exampleChinese: 莉娜和奥马尔分别于周一和周二到达，因此参加了学院不同的迎新活动。

collocations.chinese: 年龄分别为十岁和十二岁

ngsl12:variation.exampleEnglish: There is considerable variation in ticket prices, depending on how early you book and which day you travel.
ngsl12:variation.exampleChinese: 票价差异相当大，具体取决于提前多久预订以及哪天出行。

ngsl12:ultimately.exampleEnglish: Although the team considered several exciting ideas, the final choice ultimately depended on what the school could afford.
ngsl12:ultimately.exampleChinese: 尽管团队考虑了几个令人兴奋的想法，最终选择还是取决于学校的负担能力。

ngsl12:proof.exampleEnglish: The photographs provided proof that the package had been damaged before it arrived at the customer's home.
ngsl12:proof.exampleChinese: 这些照片提供了证据，证明包裹在送达客户家之前就已损坏。

ngsl12:soil.exampleEnglish: The gardeners added compost to the soil before planting vegetables that needed plenty of nutrients to grow well.
ngsl12:soil.exampleChinese: 园丁们先向土壤添加堆肥，再种植需要充足养分才能茁壮生长的蔬菜。

ngsl12:smart.exampleEnglish: Choosing a reusable bottle was a smart decision because it saved money and reduced the amount of waste.
ngsl12:smart.exampleChinese: 选择可重复使用的瓶子是个明智的决定，因为它既省钱又减少垃圾。

ngsl12:layer.exampleEnglish: A thin layer of ice covered the path, so we walked slowly and held onto the railing.
ngsl12:layer.exampleChinese: 小路上覆盖着薄薄一层冰，因此我们走得很慢，并扶着栏杆。

ngsl12:upset.exampleEnglish: She felt upset after missing the meeting, even though her colleagues assured her that they understood the situation.
ngsl12:upset.exampleChinese: 错过会议后，她很难过，尽管同事们向她保证理解当时的情况。

ngsl12:tooth.exampleEnglish: The child proudly showed us a loose tooth while explaining that another one was already beginning to appear.
ngsl12:tooth.exampleChinese: 孩子自豪地让我们看一颗松动的牙齿，同时解释说另一颗已经开始长出来了。

ngsl12:representation.exampleEnglish: The committee asked for student representation so that decisions about the library would reflect how young people used it.
ngsl12:representation.exampleChinese: 委员会要求学生参与代表工作，让图书馆的相关决策能反映年轻人的使用方式。

ngsl12:preparation.exampleEnglish: Careful preparation allowed the volunteers to serve everyone quickly, even though more visitors arrived than they had expected.
ngsl12:preparation.exampleChinese: 周密准备使志愿者迅速服务了所有人，尽管来客比预期更多。

ngsl12:dispute.exampleEnglish: A dispute over the delivery date was settled after both sides checked the original order and email messages.
ngsl12:dispute.exampleChinese: 双方核对原订单和电子邮件后，一场关于交货日期的争议得到解决。

ngsl12:agenda.exampleEnglish: We added transport to the agenda because several members had raised concerns about reaching the venue on time.
ngsl12:agenda.exampleChinese: 我们把交通问题加入议程，因为几个成员担心无法准时到达会场。

ngsl12:emphasis.exampleEnglish: The course places emphasis on practical communication rather than asking students to memorize long lists of grammatical terms.
ngsl12:emphasis.exampleChinese: 课程强调实际交流，而不是要求学生背诵很长的语法术语表。

ngsl12:edition.exampleEnglish: The latest edition includes updated maps, which should help travellers avoid roads that are no longer open.
ngsl12:edition.exampleChinese: 最新版包含更新后的地图，应该能帮助旅行者避开已经关闭的道路。

ngsl12:silver.exampleEnglish: The ring was made of silver rather than gold, which suited her preference for simple, pale jewellery.
ngsl12:silver.exampleChinese: 这枚戒指由银而非金制成，符合她对简洁、浅色首饰的偏好。

ngsl12:entertainment.exampleEnglish: The hotel provides evening entertainment, although guests who prefer a quiet night can use the upstairs lounge.
ngsl12:entertainment.exampleChinese: 酒店提供晚间娱乐活动，不过喜欢安静夜晚的客人可以使用楼上的休息室。

ngsl12:honest.exampleEnglish: Please give me an honest answer, even if you think I might be disappointed by your opinion.
ngsl12:honest.exampleChinese: 请给我一个诚实的回答，即使你认为你的看法可能会让我失望。

ngsl12:undertake.exampleEnglish: The charity agreed to undertake the repairs once enough volunteers with the necessary experience had offered their help.
ngsl12:undertake.exampleChinese: 足够多具备所需经验的志愿者表示愿意帮忙后，这家慈善机构同意着手修缮。

ngsl12:retail.exampleEnglish: She gained retail experience in a local bookshop before applying for a job managing a larger store.
ngsl12:retail.exampleChinese: 她先在当地书店积累零售经验，再申请管理一家更大商店的工作。

ngsl12:wire.exampleEnglish: We used a piece of wire to support the young plant until its stem grew strong enough.
ngsl12:wire.exampleChinese: 我们用一段金属丝支撑这棵幼苗，直到它的茎长得足够结实。

ngsl12:unlikely.exampleEnglish: It seems unlikely that the outdoor concert will continue if the forecast of heavy rain proves correct.
ngsl12:unlikely.exampleChinese: 如果大雨预报准确，室外音乐会似乎不太可能继续进行。

ngsl12:gay.exampleEnglish: The novel follows a gay teenager whose family supports him as he learns to speak openly about his identity.
ngsl12:gay.exampleChinese: 这部小说讲述一位同性恋少年的故事，家人在他学会公开谈论身份的过程中支持着他。

ngsl12:publication.exampleEnglish: The author checked every reference carefully before publication because several readers might want to consult the original sources.
ngsl12:publication.exampleChinese: 出版前，作者仔细核对每条参考资料，因为一些读者可能想查阅原始来源。

ngsl12:slight.exampleEnglish: There was a slight delay at the entrance while staff checked whether everyone had the correct ticket.
ngsl12:slight.exampleChinese: 工作人员核查每个人的票是否正确时，入口处出现了短暂延误。

ngsl12:unknown.exampleEnglish: The artist was still unknown when a small local gallery offered to display her photographs for the first time.
ngsl12:unknown.exampleChinese: 当地一家小画廊首次提出展出她的照片时，这位艺术家还不为人知。

ngsl12:framework.exampleEnglish: The agreement provides a framework for cooperation while leaving individual schools free to develop their own activities.
ngsl12:framework.exampleChinese: 协议为合作提供了框架，同时让各学校自由开展自己的活动。

ngsl12:zone.exampleEnglish: Visitors must leave their cars outside the pedestrian zone so that families can explore the old town safely.
ngsl12:zone.exampleChinese: 游客必须把车停在步行区外，让家庭游客能安全游览老城区。

ngsl12:restrict.exampleEnglish: The museum may restrict access to certain rooms while workers repair the damaged ceiling above the main staircase.
ngsl12:restrict.exampleChinese: 工人修理主楼梯上方受损天花板时，博物馆可能限制进入某些房间。

ngsl12:trace.exampleEnglish: By checking old photographs, we managed to trace the path that the river followed before the town expanded.
ngsl12:trace.exampleChinese: 通过查看老照片，我们成功追溯了城镇扩张前河流所经过的路线。

ngsl12:inch.exampleEnglish: Move the shelf an inch to the left so that the cupboard door can open without catching it.
ngsl12:inch.exampleChinese: 把架子向左移动一英寸，让柜门打开时不会碰到它。

ngsl12:equivalent.exampleEnglish: The two qualifications are broadly equivalent, although employers may prefer one depending on the role you apply for.
ngsl12:equivalent.exampleChinese: 这两项资格大致相当，但雇主可能根据你申请的职位偏好其中一种。

ngsl12:solid.exampleEnglish: The table needs a solid base because it will hold several heavy pieces of equipment during the demonstration.
ngsl12:solid.exampleChinese: 桌子需要结实的底座，因为演示期间会放置几件沉重的设备。

ngsl12:enterprise.exampleEnglish: The social enterprise uses its profits to provide affordable meals for people living in the surrounding neighbourhood.
ngsl12:enterprise.exampleChinese: 这家社会企业用利润为周边社区的居民提供价格实惠的饭菜。

ngsl12:elderly.exampleEnglish: The new bus service helps elderly residents reach the shops without having to walk up the steep hill.
ngsl12:elderly.exampleChinese: 新的公交服务帮助老年居民去商店，不必再步行爬上陡坡。

ngsl12:owe.exampleEnglish: I still owe my sister some money because she paid for both tickets when I forgot my wallet.
ngsl12:owe.exampleChinese: 我还欠姐姐一些钱，因为我忘带钱包时，她支付了两张票的费用。

ngsl12:governor.exampleEnglish: The governor visited the damaged town and spoke with residents about which public services needed attention first.
ngsl12:governor.exampleChinese: 州长访问了受灾城镇，并与居民讨论哪些公共服务最需要优先处理。

ngsl12:uniform.exampleEnglish: Students can wear a light jacket over their uniform when the classrooms become cold during winter mornings.
ngsl12:uniform.exampleChinese: 冬天早晨教室变冷时，学生可以在校服外面穿一件薄夹克。

ngsl12:port.exampleEnglish: The ship remained in the port until the strong winds had passed and conditions were safe again.
ngsl12:port.exampleChinese: 船一直停在港口，直到强风过去、条件重新变得安全。

ngsl12:pitch.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to notice how the pitch changed when the singer moved to a higher note.
ngsl12:pitch.exampleChinese: 老师让我们注意歌手唱到更高音符时，音高如何变化。

ngsl12:arrival.exampleEnglish: We prepared a simple meal before their arrival so that everyone could relax after the long journey.
ngsl12:arrival.exampleChinese: 他们到来前，我们准备了一顿简餐，让大家长途旅行后都能放松。

ngsl12:contemporary.exampleEnglish: The exhibition places the painter's work beside contemporary photographs to show how people dressed during that period.
ngsl12:contemporary.exampleChinese: 展览把画家的作品与同时代照片并列，展示当时人们的穿着。

ngsl12:gate.exampleEnglish: Please close the garden gate behind you because the dog may run towards the road if it escapes.
ngsl12:gate.exampleChinese: 请随手关好花园门，因为狗跑出去后可能会冲向公路。

ngsl12:ease.exampleEnglish: Her friendly introduction put the visitors at ease before they began discussing the questions that concerned them.
ngsl12:ease.exampleChinese: 她友好的开场白让来访者放松下来，然后他们开始讨论关心的问题。

ngsl12:beer.exampleEnglish: The restaurant serves local beer, but it also offers several alcohol-free drinks for guests who prefer them.
ngsl12:beer.exampleChinese: 这家餐馆供应本地啤酒，也为有需要的客人提供几种无酒精饮料。

ngsl12:specialist.exampleEnglish: The school invited a reading specialist to suggest activities for pupils who needed more support with longer texts.
ngsl12:specialist.exampleChinese: 学校邀请阅读专家，为阅读长篇文章需要更多支持的学生推荐活动。

ngsl12:assure.exampleEnglish: The organiser called to assure us that our seats would be reserved despite the delay to our train.
ngsl12:assure.exampleChinese: 组织者打电话向我们保证，尽管火车延误，我们的座位仍会保留。

ngsl12:profile.exampleEnglish: Read the speaker's profile before the event so that you can prepare questions relevant to her research.
ngsl12:profile.exampleChinese: 活动前先阅读演讲者的简介，这样就能准备与她的研究相关的问题。

ngsl12:mood.exampleEnglish: The cheerful music improved everyone's mood while we waited for the rain to stop outside the café.
ngsl12:mood.exampleChinese: 我们在咖啡馆里等外面停雨时，欢快的音乐让大家的心情好了起来。

ngsl12:episode.exampleEnglish: Each episode follows a different family as they try to reduce waste and save money at home.
ngsl12:episode.exampleChinese: 每一集都跟随一个不同的家庭，看他们如何尝试在家减少浪费并省钱。

ngsl12:crack.exampleEnglish: Do not pour boiling water into the cold glass because the sudden temperature change could make it crack.
ngsl12:crack.exampleChinese: 不要把开水倒进冷玻璃杯，因为温度突变可能使它裂开。

ngsl12:numerous.exampleEnglish: We received numerous suggestions after inviting residents to explain how they wanted the empty building to be used.
ngsl12:numerous.exampleChinese: 邀请居民说明希望如何使用空置建筑后，我们收到了许多建议。

ngsl12:submit.exampleEnglish: In the story, the villagers refuse to submit to a ruler who keeps changing the rules without warning.
ngsl12:submit.exampleChinese: 故事里，村民拒绝屈服于一位总是不事先通知就改变规则的统治者。

ngsl12:symptom.exampleEnglish: The leaflet describes a common symptom that readers might recognize, but advises them to seek professional guidance.
ngsl12:symptom.exampleChinese: 这份传单描述了一种读者可能认出的常见症状，但建议他们寻求专业指导。

ngsl12:virtually.exampleEnglish: After the new road opened, the journey became so short that traffic delays were virtually eliminated.
ngsl12:virtually.exampleChinese: 新路开通后，路程变得很短，交通延误几乎消失了。

ngsl12:era.exampleEnglish: The photographs capture an era when most residents walked to work and few families owned a car.
ngsl12:era.exampleChinese: 这些照片记录了一个多数居民步行上班、很少有家庭拥有汽车的时代。

ngsl12:coverage.exampleEnglish: The channel's coverage of the festival included interviews with local artists as well as scenes from the performances.
ngsl12:coverage.exampleChinese: 该频道的节日报道既包括对当地艺术家的采访，也包括演出画面。

ngsl12:tension.exampleEnglish: A short break helped reduce the tension after the group struggled to agree on how to divide the work.
ngsl12:tension.exampleChinese: 小组难以就分工达成一致后，短暂休息有助于缓解紧张气氛。

ngsl12:cable.exampleEnglish: Make sure the cable is long enough before moving the desk to the other side of the room.
ngsl12:cable.exampleChinese: 把书桌移到房间另一侧前，要确保电缆足够长。

ngsl12:sensitive.exampleEnglish: The old photographs are sensitive to strong light, so the museum displays them only for short periods.
ngsl12:sensitive.exampleChinese: 老照片容易受强光损伤，因此博物馆只把它们短时间展出。

ngsl12:nervous.exampleEnglish: I felt nervous before the interview, but the welcoming receptionist helped me relax while I waited outside.
ngsl12:nervous.exampleChinese: 面试前我很紧张，不过我在外等候时，热情的接待员帮我放松了下来。

ngsl12:input.exampleEnglish: Please input the address carefully because even a small mistake could send the package to another town.
ngsl12:input.exampleChinese: 请仔细输入地址，因为即使一个小错误也可能让包裹被送到另一个镇。

ngsl12:isolate.exampleEnglish: The researchers decided to isolate the damaged samples so that they would not be confused with the others.
ngsl12:isolate.exampleChinese: 研究人员决定把受损样本分开，避免与其他样本混淆。

ngsl12:prisoner.exampleEnglish: The documentary followed a former prisoner who was learning new skills and trying to rebuild his life.
ngsl12:prisoner.exampleChinese: 这部纪录片跟拍了一位前囚犯，他正在学习新技能，努力重建生活。

ngsl12:eliminate.exampleEnglish: Checking the list together should eliminate most errors before we send the invitations to everyone taking part.
ngsl12:eliminate.exampleChinese: 大家一起核对名单，应该能在发出活动邀请前消除大部分错误。

ngsl12:tight.exampleEnglish: The lid was so tight that I asked my brother to help me open the jar.
ngsl12:tight.exampleChinese: 盖子太紧了，我只好请哥哥帮忙打开罐子。

ngsl12:wet.exampleEnglish: Our shoes were still wet after the walk, so we left them near the door overnight.
ngsl12:wet.exampleChinese: 步行后鞋子还湿着，因此我们把它们放在门边晾了一夜。

ngsl12:secondary.exampleEnglish: Cost was a secondary concern because the committee first wanted to find the safest option for children.
ngsl12:secondary.exampleChinese: 费用是次要问题，因为委员会首先希望找到对孩子最安全的方案。

ngsl12:welfare.exampleEnglish: The report examines whether the welfare system gives enough support to families who temporarily lose their income.
ngsl12:welfare.exampleChinese: 报告考察福利制度是否为暂时失去收入的家庭提供了足够支持。

ngsl12:recruit.exampleEnglish: The club hopes to recruit more volunteers before the summer programme begins, especially people with practical gardening experience.
ngsl12:recruit.exampleChinese: 俱乐部希望在暑期项目开始前招募更多志愿者，尤其是有园艺实践经验的人。

ngsl12:exclude.exampleEnglish: We should not exclude anyone from the discussion simply because they have less experience than other members.
ngsl12:exclude.exampleChinese: 我们不应仅仅因为某人经验比其他成员少，就把他们排除在讨论之外。

ngsl12:string.exampleEnglish: Tie the parcel with string before carrying it downstairs so that the loose books cannot fall out.
ngsl12:string.exampleChinese: 把包裹用细绳绑好再搬下楼，以免散放的书掉出来。

ngsl12:cloud.exampleEnglish: A dark cloud appeared above the hills just as we were deciding whether to continue our walk.
ngsl12:cloud.exampleChinese: 就在我们决定是否继续步行时，一朵乌云出现在山丘上方。

ngsl12:persuade.exampleEnglish: We managed to persuade our neighbour to join the walk by explaining that the route was quite gentle.
ngsl12:persuade.exampleChinese: 我们说明这条路线相当平缓，成功说服邻居一起散步。

ngsl12:inspire.exampleEnglish: The teacher hopes to inspire her students by showing them how ordinary people can solve difficult community problems.
ngsl12:inspire.exampleChinese: 老师希望通过展示普通人如何解决困难的社区问题，来激励学生。

ngsl12:grand.exampleEnglish: The old station has a grand entrance that reminds visitors how important railway travel once was.
ngsl12:grand.exampleChinese: 旧车站拥有宏伟的入口，让游客想起铁路旅行曾经多么重要。

ngsl12:hence.exampleEnglish: The museum will reopen two weeks hence, once workers have finished repairing the entrance and replacing the lighting.
ngsl12:hence.exampleChinese: 博物馆将在两周后重新开放，届时工人将完成入口修缮及照明更换。

ngsl12:crew.exampleEnglish: The crew checked the lifeboats carefully before passengers were allowed to board the ship for the evening crossing.
ngsl12:crew.exampleChinese: 乘客获准登船参加晚间航程之前，船员们仔细检查了救生艇。

ngsl12:phenomenon.exampleEnglish: The students investigated a natural phenomenon that occurs when sunlight passes through tiny drops of water.
ngsl12:phenomenon.exampleChinese: 学生们研究了一种自然现象，它发生在阳光穿过微小水滴时。

ngsl12:pupil.exampleEnglish: Each pupil chose a favourite book and explained to a partner why they thought it was worth reading.
ngsl12:pupil.exampleChinese: 每位小学生选了一本喜欢的书，并向同伴说明为什么值得读。

ngsl12:false.exampleEnglish: The notice contained false information about the opening hours, so several visitors arrived after the building had closed.
ngsl12:false.exampleChinese: 通知中的开放时间信息不实，因此几位游客到达时建筑已经关闭。

ngsl12:assist.exampleEnglish: A member of staff will assist you with the form if any of the questions are unclear.
ngsl12:assist.exampleChinese: 如果表格上有任何问题不清楚，工作人员会协助你填写。

ngsl12:restore.exampleEnglish: The town plans to restore the old theatre so that local groups can use it for performances again.
ngsl12:restore.exampleChinese: 镇里计划修复旧剧院，让当地团体能再次在那里演出。

ngsl12:formula.exampleEnglish: The chef developed a simple formula for planning meals that kept costs low without making the menu repetitive.
ngsl12:formula.exampleChinese: 厨师制定了一套简单的配餐方法，既控制成本，又不让菜单重复单调。

ngsl12:alter.exampleEnglish: We may need to alter the schedule if the earlier train arrives too late for the first session.
ngsl12:alter.exampleChinese: 如果前一班火车的到达时间赶不上第一场活动，我们可能需要调整日程。

ngsl12:perceive.exampleEnglish: People may perceive the same colour differently when it appears against a lighter or darker background.
ngsl12:perceive.exampleChinese: 当同一种颜色出现在较浅或较深的背景上时，人们的感知可能不同。

ngsl12:routine.exampleEnglish: Adding a short walk to my morning routine helped me feel more awake before starting work at home.
ngsl12:routine.exampleChinese: 把短时间散步加入早晨的日常安排，让我在开始居家办公前更清醒。

ngsl12:sink.exampleEnglish: If the small boat begins to sink, the passengers must follow the crew's instructions rather than panic.
ngsl12:sink.exampleChinese: 如果小船开始下沉，乘客必须遵从船员指示，而不是惊慌失措。

ngsl12:stare.exampleEnglish: It is difficult to concentrate when people stare at you, even if they are only curious about your work.
ngsl12:stare.exampleChinese: 有人盯着你看时很难集中注意力，即使他们只是对你的工作好奇。

ngsl12:anymore.exampleEnglish: We do not print the weekly timetable anymore because most visitors prefer to check updates on their phones.
ngsl12:anymore.exampleChinese: 我们不再打印每周时间表，因为多数游客更愿意在手机上查看更新。

ngsl12:hero.exampleEnglish: The story's hero succeeds by listening to others rather than pretending that he can solve every problem alone.
ngsl12:hero.exampleChinese: 故事的主人公通过倾听他人而成功，而不是假装自己能独力解决所有问题。

ngsl12:supporter.exampleEnglish: As a long-time supporter of the library, she helped organise an event to raise money for new books.
ngsl12:supporter.exampleChinese: 作为图书馆的长期支持者，她帮助组织了一场为购置新书筹款的活动。

ngsl12:convert.exampleEnglish: We plan to convert the empty shop into a community room where neighbours can meet and share skills.
ngsl12:convert.exampleChinese: 我们计划把空商店改成社区活动室，让邻居们见面并交流技能。

ngsl12:steady.exampleEnglish: Hold the ladder steady while I reach the top shelf, otherwise the box may fall onto the floor.
ngsl12:steady.exampleChinese: 我够顶层架子时，请扶稳梯子，否则箱子可能会掉到地上。

ngsl12:meter.exampleEnglish: The narrow path was less than a meter wide, so we had to walk one behind another.
ngsl12:meter.exampleChinese: 这条狭窄的小路不到一米宽，因此我们只能一个接一个地走。

ngsl12:truck.exampleEnglish: A truck blocked the entrance while workers unloaded the chairs that we needed for the afternoon event.
ngsl12:truck.exampleChinese: 工人卸下午活动需要的椅子时，一辆卡车挡住了入口。

ngsl12:nose.exampleEnglish: The child held his nose because the strong smell from the paint made him feel uncomfortable.
ngsl12:nose.exampleChinese: 孩子捂住鼻子，因为油漆的刺鼻气味让他觉得不舒服。

ngsl12:beside.exampleEnglish: We found a quiet place beside the river where we could eat lunch and watch the passing boats.
ngsl12:beside.exampleChinese: 我们在河边找了个安静的地方，可以吃午饭、看船来来往往。

ngsl12:sail.exampleEnglish: We hoped to sail around the island, but strong winds meant we had to postpone the trip.
ngsl12:sail.exampleChinese: 我们希望绕岛航行，但强风让我们不得不推迟行程。

ngsl12:disaster.exampleEnglish: The community centre became a temporary shelter after the disaster left many families unable to return home.
ngsl12:disaster.exampleChinese: 灾难导致许多家庭无法返家后，社区中心成了临时避难所。

ngsl12:pace.exampleEnglish: We walked at a comfortable pace so that everyone could enjoy the views without feeling rushed or tired.
ngsl12:pace.exampleChinese: 我们以舒适的速度步行，让每个人都能欣赏风景，而不感到匆忙或疲惫。

ngsl12:heavily.exampleEnglish: It rained heavily throughout the morning, so the organisers moved most of the activities into the sports hall.
ngsl12:heavily.exampleChinese: 整个上午都下着大雨，因此组织者把大部分活动移到了体育馆。

ngsl12:devote.exampleEnglish: She decided to devote one evening a week to helping neighbours practise the language they were learning.
ngsl12:devote.exampleChinese: 她决定每周抽出一个晚上，帮助邻居练习正在学习的语言。

ngsl12:terrorist.exampleEnglish: The article examined how communities rebuilt trust after a terrorist attack without blaming people for their background.
ngsl12:terrorist.exampleChinese: 这篇文章探讨了恐怖袭击后社区如何重建信任，同时不因人们的背景而责怪他们。

ngsl12:justify.exampleEnglish: You will need to justify the extra expense by explaining how the new equipment will improve our work.
ngsl12:justify.exampleChinese: 你需要解释新设备如何改善工作，以证明这项额外支出的合理性。

ngsl12:vital.exampleEnglish: Reliable transport is vital for residents who need to reach work, shops, or medical appointments outside the village.
ngsl12:vital.exampleChinese: 对于需要去村外上班、购物或就医的居民来说，可靠的交通至关重要。

ngsl12:fascinate.exampleEnglish: Stories about distant planets fascinate the children because they raise questions that even scientists are still exploring.
ngsl12:fascinate.exampleChinese: 遥远行星的故事令孩子们着迷，因为它们提出的问题连科学家也仍在探索。

ngsl12:external.exampleEnglish: The external doors will remain locked while the building is closed, but staff can enter through the side entrance.
ngsl12:external.exampleChinese: 建筑关闭期间，外门将保持锁闭，但员工可从侧门进入。

ngsl12:spare.exampleEnglish: Keep a spare key with someone you trust in case you accidentally lock yourself out of the house.
ngsl12:spare.exampleChinese: 把备用钥匙交给一个信任的人，以防你不小心把自己锁在门外。

ngsl12:whenever.exampleEnglish: You can contact the support team whenever you need help, although replies may take longer at weekends.
ngsl12:whenever.exampleChinese: 你需要帮助时随时可以联系支持团队，不过周末回复可能较慢。

ngsl12:depression.exampleEnglish: The novel describes her depression with care, showing how difficult it becomes to enjoy activities she once loved.
ngsl12:depression.exampleChinese: 小说细致地描写了她的抑郁，展现她难以再享受曾经热爱的活动。

ngsl12:guilty.exampleEnglish: He felt guilty about forgetting the meeting because his colleague had spent the morning preparing for it.
ngsl12:guilty.exampleChinese: 他因忘记会议而内疚，因为同事为此准备了整个上午。

ngsl12:underlie.exampleEnglish: Layers of older rock underlie the town, which explains why the builders requested a detailed geological survey.
ngsl12:underlie.exampleChinese: 更古老的岩层位于城镇下方，这说明建筑人员为何要求进行详细地质勘测。

collocations.chinese: 位于某地区下方的岩石

ngsl12:mom.exampleEnglish: My mom taught me to check the whole recipe before cooking so that I would not forget important ingredients.
ngsl12:mom.exampleChinese: 妈妈教我做饭前先看完整个食谱，以免漏掉重要食材。

ngsl12:distinction.exampleEnglish: The course makes a clear distinction between checking facts and expressing opinions, although both are important skills.
ngsl12:distinction.exampleChinese: 课程明确区分核查事实与表达观点，尽管两者都是重要技能。

ngsl12:satisfaction.exampleEnglish: There was real satisfaction in seeing the empty courtyard become a garden that everyone in the building could enjoy.
ngsl12:satisfaction.exampleChinese: 看着空院子变成楼里每个人都能享用的花园，确实让人满足。

ngsl12:incorporate.exampleEnglish: We should incorporate the students' suggestions into the final design because they will use the room every day.
ngsl12:incorporate.exampleChinese: 我们应该把学生的建议纳入最终设计，因为他们每天都会使用这个房间。

ngsl12:pour.exampleEnglish: Please pour the juice into smaller glasses so that every child can have some before we open another carton.
ngsl12:pour.exampleChinese: 请把果汁倒进小杯子，让每个孩子都先喝到一些，然后再开另一盒。

ngsl12:sweep.exampleEnglish: We need to sweep the floor before moving the furniture back, otherwise dust will collect under the heavy shelves.
ngsl12:sweep.exampleChinese: 搬回家具前需要扫地，否则灰尘会积在沉重的架子下面。

ngsl12:obligation.exampleEnglish: Taking care of shared equipment is everyone's obligation, since another group will need to use it tomorrow.
ngsl12:obligation.exampleChinese: 爱护共用设备是每个人的义务，因为明天另一个小组还需要使用。

ngsl12:sir.exampleEnglish: Excuse me, sir, could you move your bag so that the passenger beside you has enough space?
ngsl12:sir.exampleChinese: 打扰一下，先生，您能挪一下包，让旁边的乘客有足够空间吗？

ngsl12:evaluate.exampleEnglish: The team will evaluate each proposal by comparing its cost, likely benefits, and effect on the surrounding neighbourhood.
ngsl12:evaluate.exampleChinese: 团队将通过比较成本、预期效益及对周边社区的影响，评估每项提案。

ngsl12:anger.exampleEnglish: Sudden changes to the timetable may anger passengers who have already arranged their journeys around the published schedule.
ngsl12:anger.exampleChinese: 时刻表突然变动可能激怒已经按公布时间安排好行程的乘客。

ngsl12:pub.exampleEnglish: We met at a quiet pub near the station because it served reasonably priced meals throughout the evening.
ngsl12:pub.exampleChinese: 我们在车站附近一家安静的酒吧见面，因为那里整晚供应价格合理的饭菜。

ngsl12:perception.exampleEnglish: Travelling through the region changed my perception of it because everyday life differed greatly from the television reports.
ngsl12:perception.exampleChinese: 穿行这个地区改变了我对它的看法，因为日常生活与电视报道差别很大。

ngsl12:naturally.exampleEnglish: After weeks of practising the route, she naturally felt more confident about cycling to work on her own.
ngsl12:naturally.exampleChinese: 练习这条路线几周后，她自然对独自骑车上班更有信心了。

ngsl12:currency.exampleEnglish: Check which currency the website uses before paying, since the displayed price may not include conversion charges.
ngsl12:currency.exampleChinese: 付款前请检查网站使用哪种货币，因为显示的价格可能不含兑换费用。

ngsl12:database.exampleEnglish: The library uses a database to record which books are available and when borrowed copies should be returned.
ngsl12:database.exampleChinese: 图书馆用数据库记录哪些书可借，以及借出的书何时应归还。

ngsl12:initially.exampleEnglish: We initially planned a larger event, but the limited space persuaded us to invite fewer people this time.
ngsl12:initially.exampleChinese: 我们最初计划举办更大的活动，但空间有限，让我们决定这次少邀请一些人。

ngsl12:territory.exampleEnglish: The old map shows how the kingdom's territory changed as rivers shifted and neighbouring rulers signed new agreements.
ngsl12:territory.exampleChinese: 这幅老地图展示了河流改道、邻国统治者签订新协议后，王国领土如何变化。

ngsl12:stream.exampleEnglish: We followed the stream through the woods until we reached a small bridge near the village entrance.
ngsl12:stream.exampleChinese: 我们沿着溪流穿过树林，直到来到村口附近的一座小桥。

ngsl12:rarely.exampleEnglish: We rarely eat at restaurants during the week because cooking together helps us relax after a busy day.
ngsl12:rarely.exampleChinese: 我们平日很少下馆子，因为一起做饭能帮助我们在忙碌一天后放松。

ngsl12:height.exampleEnglish: Measure the height of the doorway before buying the cupboard, otherwise you may struggle to carry it inside.
ngsl12:height.exampleChinese: 买柜子前先测量门口高度，否则可能很难把它搬进去。

ngsl12:apparent.exampleEnglish: The reason for the delay became apparent when we saw workers repairing a damaged section of the track.
ngsl12:apparent.exampleChinese: 我们看见工人正在维修受损轨道后，延误的原因就很明显了。

ngsl12:western.exampleEnglish: The western side of the island faces the open sea, so it is usually windier than the sheltered harbour.
ngsl12:western.exampleChinese: 岛的西侧面向外海，因此通常比避风的港口风更大。

ngsl12:expansion.exampleEnglish: The expansion of the library created more study space without changing the appearance of the original building.
ngsl12:expansion.exampleChinese: 图书馆的扩建增加了学习空间，同时没有改变原建筑的外观。

ngsl12:constantly.exampleEnglish: The staff constantly check the weather during outdoor events so that they can respond quickly if conditions change.
ngsl12:constantly.exampleChinese: 户外活动期间，工作人员不断查看天气，以便在情况变化时迅速应对。

ngsl12:muscle.exampleEnglish: The coach explained which muscle was working during the exercise so that students could understand the movement better.
ngsl12:muscle.exampleChinese: 教练解释了练习时哪块肌肉在发力，让学生更好地理解动作。

ngsl12:scare.exampleEnglish: Loud fireworks can scare animals, which is why the organisers warned nearby residents before the evening display.
ngsl12:scare.exampleChinese: 响亮的烟花声会吓到动物，因此组织者在晚间表演前提前通知了附近居民。

ngsl12:badly.exampleEnglish: The first attempt went badly because we had not checked whether all the equipment was working properly.
ngsl12:badly.exampleChinese: 第一次尝试很不顺利，因为我们没有检查所有设备是否都能正常工作。

ngsl12:everyday.exampleEnglish: The exhibition uses everyday objects to show how families cooked, travelled, and communicated a hundred years ago.
ngsl12:everyday.exampleChinese: 展览通过日常物品，展示一百年前的家庭如何做饭、出行和沟通。

ngsl12:boundary.exampleEnglish: A low stone wall marks the boundary between the public garden and the farmer's private field.
ngsl12:boundary.exampleChinese: 一道矮石墙标出了公共花园与农民私人田地之间的边界。

ngsl12:ratio.exampleEnglish: The teacher changed the ratio of discussion to written work after students asked for more speaking practice.
ngsl12:ratio.exampleChinese: 学生要求增加口语练习后，老师调整了讨论与书面作业的比例。

collocations.english: the ratio of one thing to another

ngsl12:essay.exampleEnglish: My essay compares two ways of reducing traffic and explains why one might work better in small towns.
ngsl12:essay.exampleChinese: 我的文章比较了两种减轻交通拥堵的方法，并解释其中一种为何可能更适合小城镇。

ngsl12:scream.exampleEnglish: The children began to scream with excitement when the enormous fountain suddenly sent water high above the square.
ngsl12:scream.exampleChinese: 巨大的喷泉突然把水喷向广场上空时，孩子们兴奋地尖叫起来。

ngsl12:withdraw.exampleEnglish: You can withdraw cash at the station, but remember that some machines may charge an additional fee.
ngsl12:withdraw.exampleChinese: 你可以在车站取现金，不过要记住有些机器可能收取额外费用。

ngsl12:pollution.exampleEnglish: The town reduced air pollution by improving buses and making it easier for residents to cycle safely.
ngsl12:pollution.exampleChinese: 镇里通过改善公交、方便居民安全骑车，减少了空气污染。

ngsl12:disorder.exampleEnglish: The files were in such disorder that we spent most of the morning finding the documents we needed.
ngsl12:disorder.exampleChinese: 文件乱得一团糟，我们花了大半个上午才找到需要的材料。

ngsl12:furniture.exampleEnglish: We chose lighter furniture so that the room could be rearranged quickly for meetings, classes, or community meals.
ngsl12:furniture.exampleChinese: 我们选择较轻的家具，让房间能迅速重新布置，用于会议、课程或社区聚餐。

ngsl12:symbol.exampleEnglish: The restored bridge became a symbol of cooperation after neighbours from both sides helped rebuild it together.
ngsl12:symbol.exampleChinese: 两岸邻居共同参与重建后，修复的桥成了合作的象征。

ngsl12:apartment.exampleEnglish: Their new apartment is smaller, but the shorter journey to work gives them more time together every evening.
ngsl12:apartment.exampleChinese: 他们的新公寓更小，不过通勤变短，让他们每晚有更多相处时间。

ngsl12:demonstration.exampleEnglish: After a short demonstration, visitors were invited to try the equipment while an instructor answered their questions.
ngsl12:demonstration.exampleChinese: 简短示范之后，游客获邀试用设备，教练则在旁回答问题。

ngsl12:analyst.exampleEnglish: The analyst compared several months of sales figures before suggesting why demand had changed in certain regions.
ngsl12:analyst.exampleChinese: 分析师比较了几个月的销售数据，然后才提出某些地区需求变化的原因。

ngsl12:platform.exampleEnglish: Please wait behind the line on the platform until the train has stopped and passengers have stepped off.
ngsl12:platform.exampleChinese: 请在站台线后等候，直到列车停稳、乘客下车。

ngsl12:steel.exampleEnglish: The new bridge uses steel supports because they can carry heavy loads while leaving more space beneath.
ngsl12:steel.exampleChinese: 新桥采用钢支架，因为它们可以承受重载，同时留出更大的下方空间。

ngsl12:cake.exampleEnglish: We kept the cake in a cool cupboard until all the guests had arrived for the birthday celebration.
ngsl12:cake.exampleChinese: 我们把蛋糕放在阴凉的柜子里，直到所有客人都到齐参加生日庆祝。

ngsl12:transform.exampleEnglish: The volunteers hope to transform the neglected yard into a colourful garden where neighbours can spend time together.
ngsl12:transform.exampleChinese: 志愿者希望把荒废的院子改造成多彩的花园，让邻居们能聚在一起。

collocations.chinese: 把某物彻底变成另一物

ngsl12:wound.exampleEnglish: The character hid a small wound on his hand because he did not want to worry his companions.
ngsl12:wound.exampleChinese: 这个角色藏起了手上的小伤口，因为他不想让同伴担心。

ngsl12:restriction.exampleEnglish: The new restriction applies only during rush hour, when delivery vehicles often block the narrow shopping street.
ngsl12:restriction.exampleChinese: 新限制只在高峰时段适用，那时送货车辆常常堵塞狭窄的购物街。

ngsl12:foundation.exampleEnglish: Builders checked the foundation carefully before adding another floor, since the extra weight could affect the whole building.
ngsl12:foundation.exampleChinese: 加建一层之前，建筑工仔细检查了地基，因为增加的重量可能影响整栋建筑。

ngsl12:designer.exampleEnglish: The designer asked residents how they used the space before drawing plans for the new community centre.
ngsl12:designer.exampleChinese: 设计师先询问居民如何使用这片空间，再绘制新社区中心的设计图。

ngsl12:strain.exampleEnglish: The unexpected number of visitors put a strain on the small team responsible for serving lunch.
ngsl12:strain.exampleChinese: 意外增加的来客数量，给负责午餐服务的小团队带来了压力。

ngsl12:innovation.exampleEnglish: The award recognises innovation that makes daily life easier without requiring people to buy expensive new equipment.
ngsl12:innovation.exampleChinese: 该奖项表彰能让日常生活更便利、又不要求人们购买昂贵新设备的创新。

ngsl12:album.exampleEnglish: We found an old album containing photographs of the village before the main road was built.
ngsl12:album.exampleChinese: 我们发现一本老相册，收录了主干道修建前这个村庄的照片。

ngsl12:singer.exampleEnglish: The singer paused between songs to explain how travelling had influenced the stories behind her latest music.
ngsl12:singer.exampleChinese: 歌手在歌曲间暂停，解释旅行经历如何影响她最新音乐背后的故事。

ngsl12:trail.exampleEnglish: We followed a marked trail through the forest, stopping occasionally to check our position on the map.
ngsl12:trail.exampleChinese: 我们沿着有标记的小径穿过森林，偶尔停下来在地图上确认位置。

ngsl12:trap.exampleEnglish: The guide showed us an old trap and explained how people once used it to catch small animals.
ngsl12:trap.exampleChinese: 导游给我们看了一个旧捕兽器，并解释人们过去如何用它捕捉小动物。

ngsl12:loose.exampleEnglish: One of the cupboard handles felt loose, so we tightened the screws before the door became difficult to open.
ngsl12:loose.exampleChinese: 柜子的一个把手有些松，因此我们在开门变得困难之前拧紧了螺丝。

ngsl12:extension.exampleEnglish: The teacher agreed to an extension because several students had been unable to access the materials over the weekend.
ngsl12:extension.exampleChinese: 老师同意延期，因为几名学生周末无法获取学习材料。

ngsl12:wealth.exampleEnglish: The exhibition shows how the city's wealth grew as merchants developed trade with ports across the sea.
ngsl12:wealth.exampleChinese: 展览展示了商人与海外港口发展贸易时，这座城市的财富如何增长。

ngsl12:gradually.exampleEnglish: As the morning mist gradually disappeared, we began to see the villages scattered across the valley below.
ngsl12:gradually.exampleChinese: 晨雾渐渐散去后，我们开始看见下方山谷中散落的村庄。

ngsl12:tank.exampleEnglish: The farmer installed a large tank to collect rainwater that could be used during the dry summer months.
ngsl12:tank.exampleChinese: 农民安装了一个大水箱收集雨水，以便在干燥的夏季使用。
ngsl12:tank.chinese: 储液或储气罐；水箱（此处义项）

ngsl12:evil.exampleEnglish: The novel's evil ruler loses power when ordinary people begin to work together instead of fearing one another.
ngsl12:evil.exampleChinese: 小说中，普通人开始合作而不再互相畏惧后，邪恶的统治者失去了权力。

ngsl12:remarkable.exampleEnglish: It was remarkable how quickly the group solved the problem once everyone had a chance to share their ideas.
ngsl12:remarkable.exampleChinese: 每个人都有机会分享想法后，小组解决问题的速度快得惊人。

ngsl12:tune.exampleEnglish: I recognized the tune immediately, although I could not remember where I had first heard it played.
ngsl12:tune.exampleChinese: 我立刻认出了这个曲调，尽管想不起第一次是在哪里听到的。

ngsl12:grass.exampleEnglish: The grass was still wet from overnight rain, so we spread a waterproof sheet before sitting down.
ngsl12:grass.exampleChinese: 夜间下雨后草地还湿着，因此我们先铺好防水垫才坐下。

ngsl12:invitation.exampleEnglish: We accepted their invitation to dinner because it would give us a chance to meet the new neighbours.
ngsl12:invitation.exampleChinese: 我们接受了他们的晚餐邀请，因为这让我们有机会结识新邻居。

ngsl12:transition.exampleEnglish: The school helped children manage the transition to a larger building by arranging visits before the new term began.
ngsl12:transition.exampleChinese: 学校在新学期前安排参观，帮助孩子适应搬到更大校舍的转变。

collocations.english: a transition to a new system

ngsl12:frighten.exampleEnglish: The sudden noise may frighten the younger children, so please explain what will happen before the demonstration starts.
ngsl12:frighten.exampleChinese: 突然的声响可能吓到年幼的孩子，所以请在演示开始前说明将会发生什么。

ngsl12:bid.exampleEnglish: We decided not to bid for the painting after the auction price rose beyond what we could afford.
ngsl12:bid.exampleChinese: 拍卖价格超出我们的承受能力后，我们决定不再竞价购买那幅画。

ngsl12:breed.exampleEnglish: The farm used to breed working horses, although most of its land is now used for growing vegetables.
ngsl12:breed.exampleChinese: 这家农场过去繁育役用马，虽然现在大部分土地用于种植蔬菜。

ngsl12:extraordinary.exampleEnglish: The team showed extraordinary patience while helping visitors who needed the same instructions explained several different ways.
ngsl12:extraordinary.exampleChinese: 团队表现出非凡的耐心，帮助那些需要以不同方式重复讲解同一说明的游客。

ngsl12:brilliant.exampleEnglish: The brilliant young engineer found a simple solution that more experienced colleagues had overlooked during earlier discussions.
ngsl12:brilliant.exampleChinese: 那位才华出众的年轻工程师找到了一个简单方案，经验更丰富的同事在此前讨论中都忽略了它。

ngsl12:adviser.exampleEnglish: The financial adviser explained the possible costs clearly before asking which option best suited the family's circumstances.
ngsl12:adviser.exampleChinese: 财务顾问先清楚说明可能的费用，再询问哪种方案最适合这个家庭的情况。

ngsl12:stem.exampleEnglish: The plant's stem bent towards the window because that side of the room received more natural light.
ngsl12:stem.exampleChinese: 植物的茎弯向窗户，因为房间那一侧有更多自然光。

ngsl12:reverse.exampleEnglish: The driver had to reverse slowly along the lane because there was not enough space to turn around.
ngsl12:reverse.exampleChinese: 司机不得不沿小巷慢慢倒车，因为没有足够空间掉头。

ngsl12:mode.exampleEnglish: Switch the camera to automatic mode if you want it to choose the settings while you concentrate on framing.
ngsl12:mode.exampleChinese: 如果你想专注构图，让相机自行选择参数，就切换到自动模式。

ngsl12:mirror.exampleEnglish: The mirror opposite the window made the small room appear brighter by reflecting light towards the darker corner.
ngsl12:mirror.exampleChinese: 窗户对面的镜子把光线反射向较暗的角落，让小房间显得更明亮。

ngsl12:awful.exampleEnglish: The weather was awful when we arrived, but the warm welcome at the guesthouse quickly improved our mood.
ngsl12:awful.exampleChinese: 我们到达时天气糟透了，但旅馆热情的欢迎很快让我们心情好转。

ngsl12:pose.exampleEnglish: The photographer asked the group to pose beside the window, where the natural light was softer and more even.
ngsl12:pose.exampleChinese: 摄影师让大家在窗旁摆好姿势，因为那里的自然光更柔和、更均匀。

ngsl12:adjust.exampleEnglish: You may need to adjust the chair before starting work so that the screen is at a comfortable height.
ngsl12:adjust.exampleChinese: 开始工作前，你可能需要调整椅子，让屏幕处于舒适的高度。

ngsl12:creative.exampleEnglish: The children found a creative way to reuse old boxes instead of throwing them away after the move.
ngsl12:creative.exampleChinese: 搬家后，孩子们找到了一种有创意的方法利用旧箱子，而不是把它们扔掉。

ngsl12:nowadays.exampleEnglish: Many travellers nowadays book their own accommodation online, although some still prefer advice from a local travel agent.
ngsl12:nowadays.exampleChinese: 如今许多旅行者在网上自行预订住宿，不过有些人仍喜欢咨询当地旅行代理。

ngsl12:poem.exampleEnglish: She chose a poem about the sea because its rhythm reminded her of waves reaching the shore.
ngsl12:poem.exampleChinese: 她选了一首关于大海的诗，因为诗的节奏让她想起海浪涌向岸边。

ngsl12:agricultural.exampleEnglish: The region's agricultural production increased after farmers began sharing equipment and learning more effective ways to manage water.
ngsl12:agricultural.exampleChinese: 农民开始共用设备并学习更有效的用水方法后，这个地区的农业产量提高了。

ngsl12:competitor.exampleEnglish: Each competitor received the same instructions before the race, so nobody would gain an advantage through better information.
ngsl12:competitor.exampleChinese: 赛前每位选手都收到相同说明，确保没有人因掌握更多信息而占优势。

ngsl12:alcohol.exampleEnglish: The café does not serve alcohol, which makes it a popular meeting place for families after school events.
ngsl12:alcohol.exampleChinese: 这家咖啡馆不供应酒精饮品，因此很受学校活动后聚会的家庭欢迎。

ngsl12:festival.exampleEnglish: The festival brings musicians from different regions together, allowing visitors to hear styles they might never encounter elsewhere.
ngsl12:festival.exampleChinese: 这个节日把各地音乐家聚在一起，让游客听到其他地方可能难以遇到的音乐风格。

ngsl12:vegetable.exampleEnglish: The farmer explained how each vegetable was grown before inviting the children to choose ingredients for their soup.
ngsl12:vegetable.exampleChinese: 农民先解释每一种蔬菜是如何种植的，再请孩子们挑选做汤的食材。

ngsl12:van.exampleEnglish: We hired a van for the move because several pieces of furniture would not fit inside an ordinary car.
ngsl12:van.exampleChinese: 我们搬家租了一辆货车，因为几件家具装不进普通汽车。

ngsl12:confident.exampleEnglish: After practising the explanation with a colleague, I felt confident that I could answer the visitors' questions clearly.
ngsl12:confident.exampleChinese: 与同事练习讲解后，我有信心能清楚回答游客的问题。

ngsl12:planet.exampleEnglish: The class designed a model planet and explained how its distance from the sun might affect its climate.
ngsl12:planet.exampleChinese: 全班设计了一颗模型行星，并解释它与太阳的距离可能如何影响气候。

ngsl12:curve.exampleEnglish: The road follows a gentle curve around the lake, giving passengers a clear view of the mountains beyond.
ngsl12:curve.exampleChinese: 道路沿着湖边缓缓转弯，让乘客能清楚看到远处群山。

ngsl12:knee.exampleEnglish: She rested her notebook on one knee while listening to the guide explain the history of the castle.
ngsl12:knee.exampleChinese: 她把笔记本放在一侧膝盖上，听导游介绍城堡的历史。

ngsl12:overcome.exampleEnglish: The group managed to overcome the language barrier by using drawings, gestures, and a shared willingness to listen.
ngsl12:overcome.exampleChinese: 通过绘图、手势和彼此愿意倾听的态度，这个小组成功克服了语言障碍。

ngsl12:web.exampleEnglish: A delicate web stretched between the branches, becoming visible when tiny drops of morning dew caught the light.
ngsl12:web.exampleChinese: 一张精巧的蜘蛛网横在树枝之间，晨露的小水珠反射光线后才显现出来。

ngsl12:depth.exampleEnglish: The guide checked the depth of the water before allowing anyone to step from the boat onto the shore.
ngsl12:depth.exampleChinese: 导游先检查水深，再允许人们从船上踏向岸边。

ngsl12:entrance.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet at the main entrance because it was easier to find than the smaller side door.
ngsl12:entrance.exampleChinese: 我们约好在正门见面，因为那里比小侧门更容易找。

ngsl12:log.exampleEnglish: The children sat on a fallen log while the guide explained how insects helped break down old wood.
ngsl12:log.exampleChinese: 孩子们坐在倒下的原木上，听导游解释昆虫如何帮助分解枯木。

ngsl12:giant.exampleEnglish: A giant screen allowed people at the back of the hall to see the demonstration more clearly.
ngsl12:giant.exampleChinese: 一块巨大的屏幕让大厅后排的人也能更清楚地观看演示。

ngsl12:god.exampleEnglish: In the ancient story, a sea god protects the sailors when they show respect for the natural world.
ngsl12:god.exampleChinese: 在这个古老故事里，水手尊重自然时，一位海神便保护他们。

ngsl12:portion.exampleEnglish: We saved a small portion of the budget for unexpected costs that might arise during the repairs.
ngsl12:portion.exampleChinese: 我们预留了一小部分预算，以应对修缮期间可能出现的意外费用。

ngsl12:substance.exampleEnglish: The laboratory examined a white substance found near the river to discover whether it came from the nearby factory.
ngsl12:substance.exampleChinese: 实验室检查了河边发现的一种白色物质，确定它是否来自附近工厂。

ngsl12:extensive.exampleEnglish: The report contains extensive information about local transport, including routes that are rarely mentioned in tourist guides.
ngsl12:extensive.exampleChinese: 报告包含大量当地交通信息，包括旅游指南中很少提及的路线。

ngsl12:interpret.exampleEnglish: Could you interpret for the visitor while I explain how the booking system works and answer her questions?
ngsl12:interpret.exampleChinese: 我解释预订系统如何运作并回答她的问题时，你能为这位访客口译吗？

ngsl12:independence.exampleEnglish: Moving into a shared apartment gave her more independence while still allowing her to split expenses with friends.
ngsl12:independence.exampleChinese: 搬进合租公寓让她更加独立，同时仍能与朋友分摊费用。

ngsl12:sugar.exampleEnglish: The recipe uses less sugar than the original version because the ripe fruit already makes the cake quite sweet.
ngsl12:sugar.exampleChinese: 这个食谱比原版少放糖，因为成熟的水果已经让蛋糕很甜。

ngsl12:inner.exampleEnglish: The inner pocket is useful for keeping tickets safe while leaving the outer pockets free for smaller everyday items.
ngsl12:inner.exampleChinese: 内袋适合安全放置车票，同时让外袋留给日常小物件。

ngsl12:harm.exampleEnglish: Leaving heavy bags on the narrow stairs could harm someone who needs to pass through in a hurry.
ngsl12:harm.exampleChinese: 把重包放在狭窄楼梯上，可能会伤到需要匆忙经过的人。

ngsl12:consult.exampleEnglish: We should consult the residents before changing the park, since they understand how the space is actually used.
ngsl12:consult.exampleChinese: 改造公园前，我们应该征求居民意见，因为他们了解这片空间实际如何被使用。

ngsl12:pink.exampleEnglish: She chose pale pink curtains because they matched the flowers painted on the wall beside the window.
ngsl12:pink.exampleChinese: 她选了浅粉色窗帘，因为它们与窗边墙上画的花朵相配。

ngsl12:shadow.exampleEnglish: We rested in the shadow of the old tower while waiting for the afternoon heat to become less intense.
ngsl12:shadow.exampleChinese: 我们在古塔的阴影里休息，等待午后的热度减弱。

ngsl12:strip.exampleEnglish: Before repainting the door, we need to strip the old paint away so that the new coat sticks properly.
ngsl12:strip.exampleChinese: 重新漆门之前，我们需要去掉旧漆，让新漆能牢固附着。

ngsl12:smooth.exampleEnglish: The smooth wooden handle was comfortable to hold, even after we had been using the tool for several hours.
ngsl12:smooth.exampleChinese: 这工具的光滑木柄握着很舒服，即使连续用了几个小时也是如此。

ngsl12:intervention.exampleEnglish: Early intervention by the manager prevented a small disagreement from becoming a problem that affected the whole team.
ngsl12:intervention.exampleChinese: 经理及早介入，避免一场小分歧发展成影响整个团队的问题。

ngsl12:impress.exampleEnglish: The presentation should impress the visitors if we explain the results clearly rather than using unnecessarily complicated language.
ngsl12:impress.exampleChinese: 如果我们清楚解释结果，而不是使用不必要的复杂语言，演示应该能给游客留下好印象。

ngsl12:exam.exampleEnglish: I reviewed my notes with a friend before the exam because explaining ideas aloud helped me notice gaps.
ngsl12:exam.exampleChinese: 考试前我和朋友复习笔记，因为把想法讲出来能帮助我发现知识漏洞。

ngsl12:vice.exampleEnglish: The novel explores greed as a vice that gradually damages the main character's friendships and sense of responsibility.
ngsl12:vice.exampleChinese: 小说把贪婪作为一种恶习来探讨，描写它如何逐渐破坏主人公的友谊和责任感。

ngsl12:radical.exampleEnglish: The committee considered a radical redesign after discovering that small adjustments would not solve the building's main problem.
ngsl12:radical.exampleChinese: 委员会发现小修小改无法解决建筑的主要问题后，考虑了彻底重新设计。

ngsl12:similarly.exampleEnglish: The two villages developed similarly because both relied on the same river for transport, farming, and local trade.
ngsl12:similarly.exampleChinese: 这两个村庄的发展方式相似，因为都依靠同一条河进行运输、农业和当地贸易。

ngsl12:behave.exampleEnglish: We explained how visitors should behave around the animals so that everyone could enjoy the farm safely.
ngsl12:behave.exampleChinese: 我们解释了在动物周围应有的行为，让所有人都能安全游览农场。

ngsl12:loud.exampleEnglish: The music was so loud that we moved to another table where we could hear each other clearly.
ngsl12:loud.exampleChinese: 音乐太响了，我们换到另一张桌子，才能清楚听见彼此说话。

ngsl12:dimension.exampleEnglish: Check each dimension of the shelf before ordering it, since the space beside the window is quite limited.
ngsl12:dimension.exampleChinese: 订购架子前核查每个尺寸，因为窗边的空间相当有限。

ngsl12:subsequent.exampleEnglish: The first meeting introduced the problem, while subsequent sessions focused on testing possible solutions with local residents.
ngsl12:subsequent.exampleChinese: 第一次会议介绍了问题，后续会议则着重与当地居民一起测试可能的解决办法。

ngsl12:infection.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains why cleaning shared equipment matters, using a simple example of how an infection can spread.
ngsl12:infection.exampleChinese: 传单用感染如何传播的简单例子，解释清洁共用设备为何重要。

ngsl12:jacket.exampleEnglish: I brought a light jacket because the forecast suggested that the temperature would fall sharply after sunset.
ngsl12:jacket.exampleChinese: 我带了一件薄夹克，因为预报显示日落后气温将明显下降。

ngsl12:efficiency.exampleEnglish: Sharing a clear timetable improved efficiency because volunteers no longer had to ask who was responsible for each task.
ngsl12:efficiency.exampleChinese: 共用明确的时间表提高了效率，因为志愿者不必再询问每项任务由谁负责。

ngsl12:dirty.exampleEnglish: The children left their dirty boots near the entrance so that they would not bring mud into the kitchen.
ngsl12:dirty.exampleChinese: 孩子们把脏靴子留在入口附近，以免把泥带进厨房。

ngsl12:statistic.exampleEnglish: The article included a statistic about commuting times, but it did not explain how the information had been collected.
ngsl12:statistic.exampleChinese: 文章引用了一项通勤时间统计数据，却没有说明信息是如何收集的。

ngsl12:regularly.exampleEnglish: We regularly check the emergency lights so that visitors can find their way out if the electricity supply fails.
ngsl12:regularly.exampleChinese: 我们定期检查应急灯，让游客在停电时也能找到出口。

ngsl12:resort.exampleEnglish: The resort offers quiet walking routes as well as crowded beaches, so visitors can choose different kinds of holiday.
ngsl12:resort.exampleChinese: 这个度假区既有安静的步道，也有热闹的海滩，因此游客能选择不同的度假方式。

ngsl12:iron.exampleEnglish: The old gate was made of iron, which explained why it was much heavier than it looked.
ngsl12:iron.exampleChinese: 旧门是铁制的，这说明它为何比看起来重得多。

ngsl12:broadcast.exampleEnglish: The station will broadcast the discussion live so that residents unable to attend can still hear the proposals.
ngsl12:broadcast.exampleChinese: 电台将直播这场讨论，让无法到场的居民也能听到提议。

ngsl12:membership.exampleEnglish: The club's membership has grown since it began offering activities that appeal to families as well as individual adults.
ngsl12:membership.exampleChinese: 俱乐部开始提供同时吸引家庭和成年个人的活动后，会员人数增加了。

ngsl12:bread.exampleEnglish: We bought fresh bread from the village bakery before setting off on the long walk along the coast.
ngsl12:bread.exampleChinese: 沿海岸长途步行出发前，我们在村里的面包店买了新鲜面包。

ngsl12:blind.exampleEnglish: The museum provides descriptions that blind visitors can listen to while exploring the exhibits with a guide.
ngsl12:blind.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供可收听的讲解，让盲人游客随导游参观展品。

ngsl12:pure.exampleEnglish: The display showed how pure copper differs from mixtures that contain other metals and have different practical uses.
ngsl12:pure.exampleChinese: 展览展示了纯铜与含有其他金属、具有不同实际用途的混合物有何差别。

ngsl12:bloody.exampleEnglish: In the story, the traveller hides a bloody bandage because he does not want his companions to worry.
ngsl12:bloody.exampleChinese: 故事里，旅行者把沾血的绷带藏了起来，因为他不想让同伴担心。

ngsl12:ally.exampleEnglish: She became a valuable ally when the group needed someone who understood both the technical details and residents' concerns.
ngsl12:ally.exampleChinese: 小组需要兼懂技术细节与居民担忧的人时，她成了一位宝贵的盟友。

ngsl12:quantity.exampleEnglish: Buy only the quantity of paint you need, since leftover materials can be difficult to store safely.
ngsl12:quantity.exampleChinese: 只购买需要的油漆用量，因为剩余材料可能难以安全存放。

ngsl12:bend.exampleEnglish: You can bend the thin wire into a hook, but avoid using force that might cause it to break.
ngsl12:bend.exampleChinese: 你可以把细铁丝弯成钩状，但要避免用力过度把它弄断。

ngsl12:mature.exampleEnglish: The garden contains mature trees that provide shade while the younger plants are still developing their roots.
ngsl12:mature.exampleChinese: 花园里有成熟的大树提供树荫，而较小的植物还在生根。

ngsl12:briefly.exampleEnglish: The guide briefly described the route before giving us maps and asking whether anyone had questions about the walk.
ngsl12:briefly.exampleChinese: 导游简要介绍路线后，给我们发地图，并询问是否有人对步行行程有疑问。

ngsl12:alarm.exampleEnglish: The alarm sounded just as we were preparing to leave, so everyone followed the marked route outside.
ngsl12:alarm.exampleChinese: 警报恰好在我们准备离开时响起，因此大家沿标明的路线走到外面。

ngsl12:disturb.exampleEnglish: Please do not disturb the visitors in the quiet room unless there is an urgent message for them.
ngsl12:disturb.exampleChinese: 除非有紧急消息要告诉他们，否则请不要打扰安静室内的访客。

ngsl12:sustain.exampleEnglish: The group needs more volunteers to sustain the weekly programme once the original organisers return to full-time work.
ngsl12:sustain.exampleChinese: 最初的组织者恢复全职工作后，这个小组需要更多志愿者维持每周活动。

ngsl12:flood.exampleEnglish: After the flood, neighbours worked together to clean the library and rescue books that could still be used.
ngsl12:flood.exampleChinese: 洪水过后，邻居们合力清理图书馆，抢救仍可使用的书籍。
